notes.title: We Grew Up in War First Look Stream!
notes.notes:
Czech and Slovak Games Week continues, and with it our stream schedule!

[b]Join us on 14th November at 16:00 CET for an exclusive stream of some levels of We Grew Up in War.[/b]

See the game in action, learn more about our gameplay, about the characters and the setting. And meet our kid protagonists!

Lucie and Ondřej will be your hosts :) So join us for a sneak peek!

Ondřej

notes.title: Our New Game Velvet 89 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Our dearest followers,
before we'll be able to show you more of our upcoming game We Grew Up in War, we'd like to share with you some exciting news - our new game [b]Velvet 89[/b] is finally out and for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133340/Velvet_89/

Velvet 89 takes you on a trip across the revolting country – from cautious ecology-themed protests to huge crowds. Investigate the moments before police brutally attacked a peaceful demonstration and unveil the stories of those who decided to speak up.

[previewyoutube=b-Uswx95FoM;full][/previewyoutube]

With Velvet 89 we put a lot of effort into a) making sure the history is represented in a nuanced and truthful manner and b) stylized visuals with a paper-like quality to them.

Velvet 89 is also available on both phone and tablet devices, on App Store and Google Play so you can explore it on whichever platform you prefer. Dive in and experience the story wherever you are!

We'd love to hear your thoughts! Leave us a review, drop a comment, and share your perspective on the power of protests—how they have shaped history and how they continue to inspire change today.
